detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The Prophet

The Prophet is a versatile character class capable of spell casting, summoning minions or phase shifting into various creatures of the wilderness. She is one with the nature and channels the energy of the forest to fight by her side.

Features

- Unleash the power of branches and roots as a spell caster. Excells at leveling and area of effect clearing.

- Summon various creatures of the forest to fight by your side: Ravens, Ents, a Carrion Worm and the Spirit of the Forest to buff your party.

- Phase shift into a Wendigo and rip your foes apart leaping around and slashing with its claws, or into an Ent or a Bear to gain survivability and deal deadly blows, or a Storm Hawk unleashing the power of lightning and flying over light terrain and water!
